blind_payload: Case labels, actual capability, sensor gain and fault identity are excluded from all AI requests. Two counterfactual hypothesis tables are shown identically, as discrete experimental evidence not live true-state forecasts.

sensing.accelerometer: Existing step2 noise/bias/gauge/latency, seed0, with registered gain on specific-force signal; no plant maximum enters estimator.

tracking.basis: Synthetic engineering trial assumptions, not actual Starship specifications. Velocity differences and modeled gravity, independent of accelerometer stream; nominal telemetry only.

switch.time: complete deorbit-burn request +600s, first scheduled control step
switch.factor: only numeric accelerometer point estimate; model never supplies a number

physics_screen.reuse: Exact original four records and calibration, bound by prior evidence SHA and unchanged numeric/physics/observation/guard sources.

calibration_gate: From saved screen telemetry, 20 seeds for each actual case plus healthy gain1 control: independent tracking band contains physical value, detects thrust deficit, and disagrees with biased accelerometer only in sensor-fault case. This is offline verification, no new propagation.
counterfactual_evidence: Exact source/record hashes and discrete point assumptions frozen after screens, before AI. Not nominal39-case fault qualification, continuous guarantee or independent physical model.

decision_policy.first: Jev chooses continue, adopt, request_independent_tracking, or explicit request_deep_reasoning. No forced tracking and no confidence-based replacement.
decision_policy.after_tracking: Jev or explicitly delegated DeepSeek chooses continue or adopt using genuinely newly delivered tracking observation. Valid choices are respected; no success-directed replacement.
decision_policy.missing: Preapproved safety net requests independent tracking if absent, then guard checks numeric compatibility before a physical choice. Fallback is never AI completion; reject conflicting accelerometer-only adoption. No universal safe-return claim.

independent_check: Separate credential-free process recomputes accelerometer and tracking estimates, causal acquisition/arrival, observation/authority/source/backend hashes, evidence and single-use application. Adoption needs independent corroboration; valid continuation remains respected.

preflight.reuse: Two original sourcefb0b01e5 fixture flights; not described as new-source flights. Repair-specific zero-model actualGateway/productionSensorAgent/mock-provider/decode/worker acceptance boundary must pass before execution.

live.completion: Same frozen propulsion-loss scenario, source changed only for model route/configuration; actual tracking request and valid final AIchoice+guard+oneuse+contact. Preserve original failed attempt; no success-rate pooling or held-out claim.

authorization.scope: One additional registered propulsion-loss flight only after explicit user approval of this prepared plan; no retries or other new flights.

interpretation: Invalid record, budgets exhausted, source/input mutation during a cohort: stop and preserve.
If physics directional gate fails: report bounded negative result, no AI flight.
If independent channel calibration fails: stop; do not tune on same registered cases.
If preflight boundary fails: stop before hosted calls, diagnose from saved artifacts.
If live AI skips acquisition, makes valid continuation/adoption, times out or fails: keep actual choice and outcome; never rerun to obtain pass.

If this one repair flight completes, combine its scoped result with preserved original trial-2 AI success. This is a source-repair confirmation on the same scenario, not a fresh two-case cohort, held-out success rate, fault robustness or hardware certification.
